---
title: "get_HDT_highest_evidence_level"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(readr)
library(tibble)
library(here)

df <- read_tsv(here("evaluation/labels/launched_drug_with_literature.tsv"))

# extract highest HDT evidence + associated PMID(s)
get_highest_HDT <- function(x) {
  
  if (is.na(x) || x == "") {
    return(tibble(
      highest_HDT_evidence = NA_character_,
      highest_HDT_PMID = NA_character_
    ))
  }
  
  # split into individual numbered studies
  studies <- str_split(x, "(?=\\[\\d+\\])")[[1]]
  
  # keep only studies explicitly tagged with HDT
  hdt_studies <- studies[
    str_detect(studies, "\\|\\s*HDT\\b")
  ]
  
  if (length(hdt_studies) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      highest_HDT_evidence = NA_character_,
      highest_HDT_PMID = NA_character_
    ))
  }
  
  # extract evidence and PMID from each HDT-tagged study
  evidence <- str_match(
    hdt_studies,
    "Evidence:\\s*([A-Za-z_]+)"
  )[, 2]
  
  pmid <- str_match(
    hdt_studies,
    "PMID:\\s*([0-9]+)"
  )[, 2]
  
  hdt_info <- tibble(
    evidence = evidence,
    pmid = pmid
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(evidence))
  
  if (nrow(hdt_info) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      highest_HDT_evidence = NA_character_,
      highest_HDT_PMID = NA_character_
    ))
  }
  
  # evidence hierarchy: highest -> lowest
  priority <- c(
    "clinical_study",
    "human_subject",
    "animal",
    "in_vitro",
    "other"
  )
  
  highest <- priority[priority %in% hdt_info$evidence][1]
  
  if (is.na(highest)) {
    return(tibble(
      highest_HDT_evidence = NA_character_,
      highest_HDT_PMID = NA_character_
    ))
  }
  
  # PMID(s) belonging specifically to the highest evidence level
  highest_pmids <- hdt_info %>%
    filter(evidence == highest) %>%
    pull(pmid) %>%
    na.omit() %>%
    unique()
  
  tibble(
    highest_HDT_evidence = highest,
    highest_HDT_PMID = ifelse(
      length(highest_pmids) > 0,
      paste(highest_pmids, collapse = "; "),
      NA_character_
    )
  )
}

results <- map_dfr(
  df$literature_evidence,
  get_highest_HDT
)

df <- bind_cols(df, results)

df %>%
  select(
    highest_HDT_evidence,
    highest_HDT_PMID,
    everything()
  )

# Summary
df %>%
  count(highest_HDT_evidence, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
drug_candidates <- c(
  "rosuvastatin",
  "fostamatinib",
  "fluvastatin",
  "tofacitinib",
  "lovastatin",
  "ethinyl-estradiol",
  "atorvastatin",
  "clonidine",
  "nabumetone",
  "tamoxifen",
  "ketotifen",
  "vemurafenib",
  "raloxifene",
  "naltrexone",
  "dasatinib",
  "chlorprothixene",
  "lapatinib",
  "forskolin",
  "sertraline",
  "mometasone"
)

# subset and preserve the order in drug_candidates
df_subset <- df %>%
  filter(tolower(drug_name) %in% tolower(drug_candidates)) %>%
  arrange(match(tolower(drug_name), tolower(drug_candidates)))

write_csv(df_subset,file=here("evaluation/labels/top20HDT_literature.csv"))
```
